dialogue.intro: And we're off!
dialogue.win: We did it, yeah!
dialogue.lose: Uncle!

dialogue.intro: My Pokémon are a cut apart from the usual. Maybe even two cuts!
dialogue.win: Their cutting intensity and solid attack... Top class, yeah?
dialogue.lose: Grr... Rendered harmless...

dialogue.intro: The prince among shorts-wearing Youngsters, that is me!
dialogue.win: I hope I lived up to my title of the prince among the shorts wearers.
dialogue.lose: I can't lose here! Not as the prince among the wearers of shorts!

dialogue.intro: I can't bear this tension. Would they be mad if I went home?
dialogue.win: I did it! I won somehow!
dialogue.lose: That's gone past my limit! I need to be excused!

dialogue.intro: I'm not very good at this, but please don't hold back.
dialogue.win: Oh, didn't I say? You shouldn't have held back.
dialogue.lose: Fweh! I wish you would have held back a little bit!

dialogue.intro: In romance, fashion, and Pokémon! Today's girls want it all!
dialogue.win: The greed of today's girls knows no bounds!
dialogue.lose: Did being greedy end up costing me everything?

dialogue.intro: I'm thinking hard about why everyone likes battling so much.
dialogue.win: Why does winning a battle make people happy?
dialogue.lose: Why is losing a battle so downright infuriating?

dialogue.intro: I'm trying to keep up with my Pokémon training and my own schooling.
dialogue.win: I'd like to think I've struck the right balance of fun and education.
dialogue.lose: This isn't going to work? My grades are the best in class, but...

dialogue.intro: I crammed hard for this. I can't possibly fail!
dialogue.win: Yes! I get the win! I'm glad I kept with this!
dialogue.lose: It means I need to study at home some more.

dialogue.intro: My Pokémon are my treasures. I'll let you see them. Just you.
dialogue.win: See? Cute and strong! Eheheheh.
dialogue.lose: See? They're cute even when losing. Eheheheh.

dialogue.intro: I won't lose ever! Please abide by my rule!
dialogue.win: Thank you so much! I owe this win to you!
dialogue.lose: I so did not want to lose...

dialogue.intro: I can do this... I can shine here, too!
dialogue.win: Yes! I won! I'm going to be a star!
dialogue.lose: One day, I'm going to shine as the brightest star in the world!

dialogue.intro: Don't be shy. You can bring it any which way.
dialogue.win: Yeah, I figured you'd be like this. Heh.
dialogue.lose: W-well, sometimes I have to lose, just so I don't crush everyone. Ahaha...

dialogue.intro: My father's wealthy. There's nothing he can't afford.
dialogue.win: My father's money bought my Pokémon.
dialogue.lose: There are things that money can't buy. I know that...

dialogue.intro: Well, shall we? Time is money, and the meter is running.
dialogue.win: Well, I'll take my leave. Yet another fancy dinner date, you know. Adieu!
dialogue.lose: It's my loss, is it? So be it. I had to leave for a date anyway.

dialogue.intro: Uphold the rules of etiquette and courtesy... That's what a lady does.
dialogue.win: If I couldn't unwind this way, I would lose my ladylike composure.
dialogue.lose: I wish I could be free like the bird Pokémon in the skies...

dialogue.intro: If I were Honey, then you would be Gooey Mulch, I would think.
dialogue.win: Do you see now? How different we are in level and class?
dialogue.lose: How dare you! I won't forget this humiliation ever!

dialogue.intro: Partying, shopping, dining... Darling, I've grown bored of it all.
dialogue.win: Excitement is so lacking in my life. What will send my heart racing?
dialogue.lose: Only battling lifts me from this idle existence of boredom and apathy...

dialogue.intro: I'm glad to make your acquaintance! May this friendship be fruitful!
dialogue.win: Thank you very much! Thank you so very much!
dialogue.lose: Thank you very much... ...Pah.

dialogue.intro: The most natural Trainer is... Oh, why hide it? None other than me!
dialogue.win: This is the natural outcome. It was inevitable!
dialogue.lose: I was battling naturally, and ended up with the loss.

dialogue.intro: Yes! Not a grown-up! Lucky me! I stand a chance!
dialogue.win: Yup, battling another kid is a lot less scary.
dialogue.lose: I get really nervous in front of grown-ups.

dialogue.intro: It's hard to keep the streak alive but the battles are fun.
dialogue.win: It's more fun to win, of course!
dialogue.lose: Even losing is fun. It's the wonder of Pokémon!

dialogue.intro: My daddy is a real mountain man. Does that make my mom a mountain woman?
dialogue.win: Mountain woman sounds icky. Not for me, thank you!
dialogue.lose: I'm their daughter. Is being a mountain woman my destiny?

dialogue.intro: I have a packed lunch all ready, and of course I have some snacks.
dialogue.win: My favorite Pokémon make winning so easy!
dialogue.lose: Oh, no, no! I forgot to bring my favorite Pokémon!

dialogue.intro: I frolic with my water Pokémon in a pool all the time.
dialogue.win: It sure makes me happy winning with my Pokémon favorites.
dialogue.lose: I'd love to swim in a pool full of water Pokémon.

dialogue.intro: I promised Mommy I'll practice swimming if I lose.
dialogue.win: Yay! I won't have to go to the pool with Mommy today!
dialogue.lose: Aww, I lost. Now I'll have to go to swimming practice today.

dialogue.intro: I went and caught my Pokémon with my daddy.
dialogue.win: I won, Daddy! Daddy, thank you!
dialogue.lose: I wonder if Daddy will show me how to train my Pokémon next?

dialogue.intro: I'm on the way home from the pool, but OK, I can battle.
dialogue.win: I hope I can go home soon. I need some dry clothes!
dialogue.lose: Ah-ah-atchoo! Aww... Atchoo! We lost...

dialogue.intro: I'm the captain of a heroic vessel among the crashing waves of a storm!
dialogue.win: Made it to shore with the ease of a real swashbuckler!
dialogue.lose: That was a bigger crash than I wanted!

dialogue.intro: I just now got back from my vacation.
dialogue.win: The beach is a good place to show off.
dialogue.lose: Ooh, my sunburn is itching.

dialogue.intro: Hunh? A battle, is that it? Sure thing, sure thing.
dialogue.win: Hey, you're something special, huh?
dialogue.lose: Yeah, thanks for your time.

dialogue.intro: This is going out to all the ladies. Babes, I sing and battle for you!
dialogue.win: My ladies, my babes, I won for you. Your love is my power, right?
dialogue.lose: I lost, but my love for the babes can't be beat...maybe.

dialogue.intro: This is no guitar I have here. It's traditional and Japanese.
dialogue.win: It has only three strings. Can you tell what this is?
dialogue.lose: My instrument is called a shamisen.

dialogue.intro: We teen Idols have a secret code of conduct that's strictly enforced.
dialogue.win: For example, if an Idol wins, she has to squeal and jump around.
dialogue.lose: If an Idol loses, she must never act angry. That's a big no-no.

dialogue.intro: Do the monster Meteor Mash! It's my catchphrase!
dialogue.win: My Meteor Mash goes to your heart!
dialogue.lose: All Idols need a catchphrase especially right after their debut.

dialogue.intro: You're ever so lucky to get the chance to battle with me.
dialogue.win: You're super lucky to even battle an Idol like me. Don't you get it?
dialogue.lose: Huh? Huh? Now, why did you win? You know I'm supposed to win!

dialogue.intro: Krink... Krak... Heheheh. Let me limber up for this.
dialogue.win: Hah! Weak, even for a joke!
dialogue.lose: Gnnrrr... I have only myself to blame...

dialogue.intro: Aren't they pretty? Adorable? They're my beloved Pokémon.
dialogue.win: You worked so hard! I'll give you a nice massage at home.
dialogue.lose: What are you doing to my Pokémon?! What if you hurt them?!

dialogue.intro: I come before you as a member of the Pokémon Fan Club! En garde!
dialogue.win: Long live the Pokémon Fan Club! May it always be glorious!
dialogue.lose: This is hardly a taste of what the Pokémon Fan Club can bring down...

dialogue.intro: Fan Club Department Manager... I hereby accept your challenge.
dialogue.win: Heheh... Honestly, you thought you stood a chance against the Fan Club?
dialogue.lose: Gwah! I will be avenged... B-by the Division Manager...

dialogue.intro: Raising Pokémon with love isn't the same as coddling them. Don't you see?
dialogue.win: Ooh, you did it! Oh, I love you so! My luvly, wuvly Pokémon!
dialogue.lose: How could you?! What if my Pokémon are injured?!

dialogue.intro: On behalf of my village, I take on this challenge!
dialogue.win: Thank you, everyone! Thank you for your vocal support!
dialogue.lose: Fellow villagers, I'm sorry! My best wasn't enough!

dialogue.intro: Thank you for your patience. Here is the battle you'd ordered.
dialogue.win: I trust you were satisfied? I feel shortchanged somewhat.
dialogue.lose: I trust you were satisfied? I've had my fill.

dialogue.intro: Work is fun, and Pokémon also. I am happy I come to this country.
dialogue.win: Having fun I am! I hoping to live here forever.
dialogue.lose: Oh, why you beat me? So mean! I want go home to my country.

dialogue.intro: I'm cool, right? So, everywhere I work they make me the maitre d'...
dialogue.win: I'm a good battler, too. I can't help it that the ladies fall for me.
dialogue.lose: I dream of evolving from a maitre d' to a celebrity chef.

dialogue.intro: There are no free deals on a battle. You'll get the full course, though.
dialogue.win: Where's the fun if you don't battle like you mean it?
dialogue.lose: I take work and play seriously. That's what sparks my passion!

dialogue.intro: Hi, may I interest you in a meal combo? ...I'm so used to saying that at work!
dialogue.win: Thank you, and have a great day! ...What am I saying?
dialogue.lose: We look forward to your next visit! ...What am I thinking?

dialogue.intro: Your team looks impressive. Will I be OK...?
dialogue.win: Oh, what? Are those Pokémon only for Contests?
dialogue.lose: Ouch! I said ouch! It was too much! Way, way too much!

dialogue.intro: I love bug Pokémon! I love my bug net even more!
dialogue.win: I caught my Pokémon using my trusty bug net.
dialogue.lose: It'd be cool if there was a bug net Pokémon.

dialogue.intro: The bugs are my minions, and I'm the boss. Are you prepared to lose?
dialogue.win: Wahaha! Well done, my minions!
dialogue.lose: We were mowed down... My minions have learned the hard way!

dialogue.intro: I'm breaking out of my shell! I'm taking it to the next level!
dialogue.win: It's like I've sprouted wings! Viva to the new me!
dialogue.lose: Is it not my time yet? Do I need to stay in my shell longer?

dialogue.intro: You transgressor! Hold still, I say!
dialogue.win: I willed myself to victory!
dialogue.lose: C-curses... I've brought dishonor on us...

dialogue.intro: Hey, hey, what's that over there? It's... It's a legendary Pokémon!
dialogue.win: Kekeke... Ninjutsu misdirection! It worked to perfection!
dialogue.lose: Ninjutsu misdirection was a failure! I'll disappear in a puff of smoke!

dialogue.intro: You'll be befuddled by my dazzling speed!
dialogue.win: Your movements... It's as if you're moving in molasses.
dialogue.lose: I didn't need to do all that dashing around, did I?

dialogue.intro: I've been wearing these clothes for a long time. Bathing is for the birds!
dialogue.win: Changing clothes takes too much effort. Taking a bath is even worse!
dialogue.lose: No, no, no! I won't take a bath!

dialogue.intro: I like my mommy, Pikachu, and my daddy too.
dialogue.win: A weak Trainer isn't cool. I don't like you.
dialogue.lose: A not-wimpy Trainer is cool. I like you.

dialogue.intro: Pikapika pikaah! Pikka! Pikachuuuh!
dialogue.win: Piika pikapikka! Pikka pikkachuuh!
dialogue.lose: Pikka ppi pi piii...

dialogue.intro: When I enter battle, I picture the vast sea in my mind.
dialogue.win: When I can envision the sea, I feel as if I could never lose.
dialogue.lose: When I envision the sea, I don't feel the sting of defeat.

dialogue.intro: In battle and in love, one needs to know when it is best to back off.
dialogue.win: After all, both battle and romance can become quagmires of despair.
dialogue.lose: I may have lost, but I said something deep, in an endless bog kind of way.

dialogue.intro: I'm afraid I got cursed on our last exploration of ancient ruins. Ehehe.
dialogue.win: Even just now, I have no idea how I won. Heeheehee.
dialogue.lose: I may be cursed, but this is fun. It is all so very good. Heeheehee.

dialogue.intro: Seeing buildings and towns from the old ages sends my pulse racing.
dialogue.win: People interested in old architecture are potential Ruin Maniacs.
dialogue.lose: Open your eyes in towns. There will be exciting new discoveries. I mean it.

dialogue.intro: I put this team together with my Internet buddies. It took us all day!
dialogue.win: We won! I need to thank my Internet buddies for their advice!
dialogue.lose: Aww, darn it! We lost?! I'll report it to my Internet buddies!

dialogue.intro: I'm the main character of this story. It's impossible for me to lose.
dialogue.win: You're good! Though, as a supporting character, you're a bit too strong.
dialogue.lose: ...The hero has to suffer a bit so the audience feels more empathy.

dialogue.intro: I'm very fickle. I can't stick with any one thing for very long.
dialogue.win: I won, and it's enough for me. I'm going to check out the Wi-Fi Plaza.
dialogue.lose: I lost, so that's enough. I'll go to the Safari Zone.

dialogue.intro: I have a ton more experience than you. What will you do about it?
dialogue.win: Not bad, but you need more maturing.
dialogue.lose: Experience alone doesn't ensure any wins, I'm learning.

dialogue.intro: Don't you think Pokémon battles are a lot like the weather?
dialogue.win: Winning makes me feel warm and cheerful like a sunny day.
dialogue.lose: Losing makes me sad like a dreary cloudy day.

dialogue.intro: I was out all night at a party again. I'm feeling dizzy from playing games!
dialogue.win: I'm so bored of fancy parties and silly games, too.
dialogue.lose: Urp...!

dialogue.intro: Ooh, aren't you the most darling thing! Can you win a smile from me?
dialogue.win: Ooh, sweetie, I win, so no smile! Be sure to win next time!
dialogue.lose: I don't feel like smiling now...but I'll be happy to wave good-bye!

dialogue.intro: ...Oh, wait one second. I have to take this call.
dialogue.win: Hi, yup... Yeah, battling... Uh-huh... Yup, I won... Well, duh... LOL...
dialogue.lose: Hi, yup... Yes, just battled... Nope... Kid beat me... Uh-huh...

dialogue.intro: Snivel! Hnurrff! Snort! This hay fever is a wicked misery...
dialogue.win: Hnurrff! Snivel! Snivel! Snivel! I won, but the misery continues!
dialogue.lose: Sniffle. Snivel. Snort. I'm not crying. My nose is running.

dialogue.intro: My acute sense of smell tells me how tough a Trainer is.
dialogue.win: Keep trying. My nose tells me you have great potential.
dialogue.lose: Sniff, sniff... Snort! My nose tells me you've been working hard!

dialogue.intro: Kyahaha! I smell a powerful battle in the making!
dialogue.win: The sweet smell of success!
dialogue.lose: Defeat smells like a Skuntank!

dialogue.intro: I like hard, fast beats in my battling and my rock 'n' roll! Let's wail!
dialogue.win: And, bam! That rhythm pattern ruled if I may say so myself!
dialogue.lose: Ouch! That's an insult to the ears! Those beats were offensive, man!

dialogue.intro: To show you how much this means to me I'll use sound effects from now on.
dialogue.win: Raaaah! Dun dun! Dun dun! Oompa-oompa-oompapa!
dialogue.lose: Blip-bip, blip-bip... Blip... Bweeee...

dialogue.intro: Wait, please wait... The winds... I hear them...
dialogue.win: I can hear them... The winds are laughing...
dialogue.lose: I can hear them... The winds... They are in tears...

dialogue.intro: I can't fly... But these babies can soar...
dialogue.win: My spirit has been uplifted to the skies... Thank you, everyone...
dialogue.lose: You broke my wings... I won't ever forget you...

dialogue.intro: Every day, I'm like a migratory bird but I go in all cardinal directions.
dialogue.win: I gained experience while traveling to all sorts of places.
dialogue.lose: I'd love to live somewhere where I can find other Trainers like you.

dialogue.intro: I was born unto rolling waves that washed me, with the beach, my cradle.
dialogue.win: I was born and grew up on the seas. That's what made me the big man I am.
dialogue.lose: I lost, did I? Time to go to the sea and stare inscrutably at it.

dialogue.intro: Youths of today aim for the world! How's that for deep!
dialogue.win: There'd be some mighty cool Trainers around the world. I'm sure of that.
dialogue.lose: Go on, kid! Take on the world! I'll look forward to your return!

dialogue.intro: What's that? I smell dusty? Don't you know the aroma of soil?
dialogue.win: See, that's what you get! Your team had to eat dirt, get it?
dialogue.lose: Dropped in the dirt by some kid who doesn't know the smell of soil!

dialogue.intro: Sorry for looking so scruffy and dirty. I've been holed up in the mountains.
dialogue.win: I wasn't really holed up, at least not on purpose. I was lost out there.
dialogue.lose: It's better to be holed up in the mountains than in your room, I say.

dialogue.intro: I'm not supposed to be here. Can we do this on the sly?
dialogue.win: Even battling can draw attention. It's not easy being a pop star.
dialogue.lose: Pop stars are ordinary girls at heart. We want to enjoy our Pokémon, too!

dialogue.intro: I'm a self-made celebrity. Do you have a problem with that?
dialogue.win: A celebrity is a celebrity, even if it's in my own mind.
dialogue.lose: I want to be the center of attention just me and only me.

dialogue.intro: I'm facing retirement soon... I was never admired as an Idol.
dialogue.win: I'm going to shine as a star battler of Pokémon!
dialogue.lose: I would have liked to end my career with a win in this match...

dialogue.intro: I think training Pokémon shares a lot of similarities with a marathon. You agree?
dialogue.win: There's meaning in sticking with your training regimen every day.
dialogue.lose: If you don't pace yourself, you can't win.

dialogue.intro: Howdy! Let's keep it clean, fair refreshing, and pleasant!
dialogue.win: Whew, I feel invigorated! Pokémon are the greatest!
dialogue.lose: Uh, haha...ha... It actually feels kinda cleansing to be thrashed this badly.

dialogue.intro: It's the Workers of the world like us who keep the world going.
dialogue.win: There are times we would like to lay down our tools and rest.
dialogue.lose: Don't forget how Workers like us work for you.

dialogue.intro: My wife and boy are waiting on me back home. I can't afford to lose!
dialogue.win: I'm sorry, but I had to do this. You'll get tougher with a family behind you.
dialogue.lose: Oh, no! How am I supposed to show my face around my dear wife and boy now?

dialogue.intro: Pokémon are like family to me. ...Nah, they are family.
dialogue.win: Yes! My family, you did it! We knocked off that mean Trainer!
dialogue.lose: Fwaaaah! That's cruel! My family's hurting!

dialogue.intro: I was too lenient with my Pokémon. They grew up all selfish on me.
dialogue.win: Hey, now, enough. Stop attacking! The battle's long over already.
dialogue.lose: Hey, now, the battle's over and done. No attacking the Trainer.

dialogue.intro: You, there. Don't look around now. Pay attention to me. Focus.
dialogue.win: Kid, you're grossly underpowered. You ought to train with me.
dialogue.lose: Oh, yeah. You're better than you look. I was wrong about you, kid.

dialogue.intro: Go, my Pokémon. But don't strain yourselves.
dialogue.win: Oh, wow, I like how tough everyone was. Our Pokémon and you, yup.
dialogue.lose: OK, nice try, gang. Thanks much for trying.

dialogue.intro: My papa's dream... I'm going to make it real.
dialogue.win: Papa, did you see? We did it all for you...
dialogue.lose: We lost... Papa, I am so sorry...

dialogue.intro: I'd like to take a break. ...No? We have to begin right away?
dialogue.win: Aww, see? You should have taken a break with me before.
dialogue.lose: Ooh, aren't you a tough one? You should take breaks, though.

dialogue.intro: Yes, yes, looking good! I need a smile now. Can you do that?
dialogue.win: No, no, no. I need a smile from you. Let's see those teeth sparkle!
dialogue.lose: Yes, that's a good smile! Now tilt your head toward me.

dialogue.intro: You probably can't tell, but I can see right down to your pores.
dialogue.win: Yes, I see it, indeed. I can see you clearly.
dialogue.lose: I zoomed in on you too much. I couldn't see your Pokémon.

dialogue.intro: While battling, I'll keep looking for the best shot of you.
dialogue.win: There! And there again! Decisive moments in time!
dialogue.lose: Shots of me losing? Those get deleted immediately.

dialogue.intro: I'll be bringing you live coverage from my imminent battle!
dialogue.win: Our intrepid and beautiful Reporter has carried the day! Go, me!
dialogue.lose: Our intrepid and beautiful Reporter has gone down in defeat. Take pity on me!

dialogue.intro: I hate admitting it, but I wanted to be an Idol, too.
dialogue.win: I didn't want to lose to any Idol. That motivated me to train.
dialogue.lose: This is crushing... I work so much harder than any silly Idol...

dialogue.intro: This microphone is what made me a star. It's my all and everything.
dialogue.win: Even for a battle, I don't let this microphone leave my hand.
dialogue.lose: ...Thud. Bzzzzt...

dialogue.intro: Hey, 'sup. I should warn you, I'm right fast, Trainer. Hold on to your hat.
dialogue.win: Trainer, from now on, you can start adding Mister to my name.
dialogue.lose: Trainer, that was a real learning experience. Thank you, seriously.

dialogue.intro: This Bike has become an extension of my very being.
dialogue.win: Any damage to my Bike, I feel the pain as if it were mine to bear.
dialogue.lose: Please! I'll ask you to keep your filthy hands off my Bike.

dialogue.intro: When I was little, I hated cycling. I couldn't get the hang of it.
dialogue.win: I love cycling now. I've made many friends riding.
dialogue.lose: Can you ride a Bike? It's healthy and a lot of fun.

dialogue.intro: I'll ride toward the breaking dawn with you on my mind.
dialogue.win: I will shift my gears higher and higher until I catch up to you...
dialogue.lose: My tires have deflated, and so has my heart...

dialogue.intro: Let the curtains rise on the festivities of muscles and Pokémon!
dialogue.win: Did you enjoy our demonstration of muscles and Pokémon?
dialogue.lose: Though I've lost, my muscles and Pokémon are seared into your mind.

dialogue.intro: They say I have fists of steel and the heart of a child.
dialogue.win: Oh, yay! Yippee! I won, I won!
dialogue.lose: Oh, boo! Boo! This stinks! I'm not talking to you!

dialogue.intro: Hwoaaah... Hwoaaah...
dialogue.win: Howatchah! Howaaatchaah!
dialogue.lose: Fweeeh... Fweeehhh...

dialogue.intro: In my dictionary, there is no entry for “restraint.”
dialogue.win: The greatest show of respect among Trainers is to battle all out.
dialogue.lose: I went all out and still lost. Of course it stings.

dialogue.intro: A professional martial artist is in perpetual control of his body.
dialogue.win: A martial artist must be more than strong. He must also be wise.
dialogue.lose: Gah! I overdid my training and ran out of stamina early...

dialogue.intro: When I close my eyes, I can picture you being defeated. Come on.
dialogue.win: Why be sad? You knew this was coming.
dialogue.lose: I berate myself for my own lack of care...

dialogue.intro: I don't like to move much. I trained using the Net and TV.
dialogue.win: Uhihi! I'm a naturally talented pro at both karate and Pokémon, I am.
dialogue.lose: Oh, man, this is rotten! I'm tired and hungry and want to go home!

dialogue.intro: ...To get this far, I had to make sacrifices. Many, many sacrifices.
dialogue.win: It's for this one moment that I live.
dialogue.lose: What else do I have to give up so I can beat you?

dialogue.intro: First, let's battle. Talking can wait.
dialogue.win: That wasn't bad at all, yup. That goes for you and your Pokémon.
dialogue.lose: You're a tough one, yup. Where do you do your training?

dialogue.intro: Cute little Trainer! We'll squash you flat.
dialogue.win: Eheh! You're so cute when you look angry and frustrated!
dialogue.lose: What do you think you're doing? I hate to lose, I'll have you know!

dialogue.intro: My precious Pokémon will set you right!
dialogue.win: My Pokémon have no flaws that you can exploit!
dialogue.lose: I apologize, my dear Pokémon... I was caught unprepared...

dialogue.intro: Fwo-fwo-fwo. Youngster, what's most important is to never give up.
dialogue.win: If you give up, that's it. The game's over.
dialogue.lose: Fwo-fwo-fwo. You're an admirable Trainer already.

dialogue.intro: I can tell by the way you look, you're quite taken with my dandy style!
dialogue.win: You shouldn't be so mesmerized by me. Like a Mothim drawn to a flame!
dialogue.lose: Oh, you're not interested in me? You're just Shellos, if I say so myself.

dialogue.intro: Oh, hello, aren't you a sweetie! Are you sure you're up to this?
dialogue.win: Oh, now, please don't cry. You should be proud of yourself, dear.
dialogue.lose: Oh, my... You're quite the capable practitioner of the art.

dialogue.intro: You and your Pokémon could use an obedience lesson from me.
dialogue.win: This isn't over until I say. Once more.
dialogue.lose: You defy me? How very amusing.

dialogue.intro: Over the years, I've crossed paths with many a Trainer.
dialogue.win: They were all wonderful Trainers in their own way. All fond memories now...
dialogue.lose: You're one among those many Trainers. I'm sorry I wasn't younger.

dialogue.intro: I am a Psychic, though I may not look like one. I'll do something psychic.
dialogue.win: I didn't use any psychic power to win. No, really.
dialogue.lose: Did you notice? I was levitating while I was in battle with you.

dialogue.intro: Fwazzam! So! You are my next victim!
dialogue.win: Fwazzam! Have you no spine?!
dialogue.lose: Fwizzle... Don't think there will be a next time!

dialogue.intro: I can use psychic power, but I prefer ordinary sleight-of-hand magic tricks.
dialogue.win: It's my opinion that psychic power should be left to the Pokémon.
dialogue.lose: I'm a Psychic, but I'm also a student of a magician's school.

dialogue.intro: In the next few minutes, you will learn true terror at my hands!
dialogue.win: Hah! Too weak! Too weak! What pitiful resistance!
dialogue.lose: Noooo! I cannot lose!

dialogue.intro: I see what I have no right seeing... Like there. Behind you.
dialogue.win: Oh? You can't see it? Then, you're fortunate. Giggle...
dialogue.lose: I wouldn't ask about what I see. It's better not to know. Really.

dialogue.intro: The great unseeable power... I beseech you for help...
dialogue.win: Oh, great unseeable power... I thank you for coming to my aid...
dialogue.lose: Oh... Great unseeable power... Why have you forsaken me...

dialogue.intro: Why do I raise Pokémon? Because they are there!
dialogue.win: I think I said something deep and cool! Didn't I?
dialogue.lose: That's no reason at all? That's the reason in itself!

dialogue.intro: My team has been raised with care. I have absolute confidence in them.
dialogue.win: You should pay closer attention to the unique aspects of your Pokémon.
dialogue.lose: How did you find my Pokémon? Did you notice their significance?

dialogue.intro: Everyone, it's showtime! Get out and do some clobbering!
dialogue.win: Oh, bravo! Nicely won!
dialogue.lose: Arrgh! How humiliating! Quick! Out of the spotlight!

dialogue.intro: I love raising Pokémon. It's what I live for!
dialogue.win: Seeing them try so hard to please... It's so unbearably adorable.
dialogue.lose: Don't you dare do that again!

dialogue.intro: I've been devising ways of raising tough Pokémon from the genetic level.
dialogue.win: You can't overlook the role of knowledge in raising tough Pokémon.
dialogue.lose: I need to study and understand what genetics is about first.

dialogue.intro: Raise them with love, and Pokémon will answer in kind. Probably.
dialogue.win: They responded to my love. Probably.
dialogue.lose: You're raising your Pokémon with a lot of love. I think.

dialogue.intro: I believe I will approach this battle from the perspective of a newborn.
dialogue.win: Abuboo dah.
dialogue.lose: Ababaa. Manmaa.

dialogue.intro: If you prevail, I'll recount to you a tale from my youth.
dialogue.win: Seeing you brings back a flood of memories. Ah, yes, indeed...
dialogue.lose: ...Hm? I seem to have forgotten...

dialogue.intro: There's no end to either adolescence or Pokémon.
dialogue.win: See ya! That was fun! Enjoy your youth!
dialogue.lose: I'm still a dreamer. A precious, unspoiled snowflake...

dialogue.intro: Daddy... Mommy... Can you hear me? Please watch over me...
dialogue.win: Daddy... Mommy... Did you see? I won, and it's all for you...
dialogue.lose: Oh... Daddy... Mommy... I couldn't win...

dialogue.intro: Finally... The time has come to put the fruits of my research to the test...
dialogue.win: Success... Sacrificing my youth was worthwhile.
dialogue.lose: No! Nooooooo! Give me back my youth!

dialogue.intro: I developed a special Pokémon drink. Have some! Bottoms up!
dialogue.win: Glug, glug... Belch! It'll make you strong! Don't waste it!
dialogue.lose: My Pokémon drink contains no actual Pokémon or their byproducts.

dialogue.intro: An analogy for battling is... I'd say a bachelor guy.
dialogue.win: Heheh, do you get it? I doubt you'd get it. No one does.
dialogue.lose: Do you get what I'm saying? I doubt you'd get it. No one ever does.

dialogue.intro: Myself, I have been born, raised, and spent my life under a circus tent.
dialogue.win: My Pokémon, too. They were born and raised under a circus tent.
dialogue.lose: The outside world is so very cruel... We shall return to our circus tent.

dialogue.intro: Oi, you! Yeah, you! Snap to it! I'll be training you!
dialogue.win: What?! You're down and out already?! This is no bed! Get up!
dialogue.lose: Good! Enough! That will do for today!

dialogue.intro: Fwah? You mean to challenge me?
dialogue.win: Fwahaha! I win! Better luck next time, punk!
dialogue.lose: Fwaah?! You defeated me? Who are you to do that?!

dialogue.intro: Ooh, it gives me shivers... I live for this moment.
dialogue.win: Oh, yeah... That's it... Perfection doesn't come better...
dialogue.lose: It's gotten so I can't live without battling anymore.

dialogue.intro: OK! I'm going to do it! I'm going to show you my best!
dialogue.win: Gasp, gasp...
dialogue.lose: Never again! You can forget about a next time!

dialogue.intro: Um... I'm honestly quite tough. Please keep up.
dialogue.win: I'm sorry. I don't think you measure up after all.
dialogue.lose: I'm amazed. I didn't think you'd win...

dialogue.intro: Let's go, me! Go, me, go! Don't lose, don't lose, rah, rah, rah!
dialogue.win: Way to go, me! I'm so wonderful! Rah, rah, rah! Gooooooo, me!
dialogue.lose: It's OK, me! Don't cry! Don't cry! Go home, go home, goooooo!

dialogue.intro: Woohoo! Here comes a cool Trainer! Let's see what you can bring!
dialogue.win: Yes! Bravo! You have some good attacks, Trainer!
dialogue.lose: Whaaaaat?! Nooooo! I can't get over how tough you are!

dialogue.intro: To serve and protect Pokémon and nature. That's my mission!
dialogue.win: My skills I developed in the embrace of Mother Nature!
dialogue.lose: My mission needs me! This is where we bid good-bye!

dialogue.intro: Never fear, this Pokémon Ranger is here to protect my own personal peace!
dialogue.win: My personal peace has been protected!
dialogue.lose: You vile Trainer, you! You've shattered my peace!

dialogue.intro: Any bad kids littering the fields? Any bad kids fouling the sea?
dialogue.win: Be sure to sort your recyclables from the trash when you're throwing it out!
dialogue.lose: Trash is like a battle. Don't be too quick to throw it!

dialogue.intro: Watch me, darling! I'm putting my best into this!
dialogue.win: See, darling? Did you see? I put in my best effort for you.
dialogue.lose: I can't have my darling see me like this. How pathetic I must look...

dialogue.intro: So, I lead with this... Then, counter... Ugh, I can't get our strategy right!
dialogue.win: To overanalyze can be a bad thing I guess.
dialogue.lose: Waaah! Couldn't you have waited? Until I'm ready at least?

dialogue.intro: How do you like my cape? I had it specially made!
dialogue.win: What is my cape made of? I'm afraid I can't tell you.
dialogue.lose: Rip... Riiiiiiiiiiiipppppp! ...What?! My cape! Waaaaah!

dialogue.intro: Do you know what real terror is? I am familiar with it. Intimately so...
dialogue.win: You learned something today, yes? The true meaning of terror.
dialogue.lose: Aiyeeh! What's with you? I'm pleading for mercy here!

dialogue.intro: See it! Hear it! Smell it! Marvel at my power!
dialogue.win: That's right! Use all your senses and realize what you were up against!
dialogue.lose: I didn't see anything! I'm not listening! And I don't smell a thing!

dialogue.intro: Unluckily for you, your winning streak ends with me.
dialogue.win: You lost to me, but you're still on your feet. Kudos to you!
dialogue.lose: This can't be. I won't accept it. There has to be a mistake somewhere.

dialogue.intro: I c-c-can't stop shivering. B-but this is a b-battle. I have to.
dialogue.win: Urrff... Ch-chatter... I won, I won...
dialogue.lose: Sh-shiver... Urf... My eyelids are getting droopy...

dialogue.intro: I'll say good-bye to you now. Battles always end in tears.
dialogue.win: Fweeeeh! My tears of joy flow freely!
dialogue.lose: Fweeeeh! My tears of anguish flow freely!

dialogue.intro: How amusing! You came here knowing of your certain defeat?
dialogue.win: Ahahahah! Very entertaining! I shall be happy to see you again!
dialogue.lose: Wh-what is happening...? M-my vision is turning milky white...

dialogue.intro: A Trainer am I, a new ray of hope from the land of the midnight sun.
dialogue.win: In the frigid falls of the north, I honed my skills. With them, I made you fall.
dialogue.lose: Your foul trickery deserves contempt. But effective it was, too.

dialogue.intro: I've been pondering lately... How much longer will I be wearing shorts?
dialogue.win: Will I still be in shorts as a grown-up?
dialogue.lose: If I grow old like this, will they call me something silly like “Shorts Man”?

dialogue.intro: That's right, I'm the legendary kid in shorts who's the talk of the town.
dialogue.win: Even a Youngster in shorts like me can be the stuff of a legend or two.
dialogue.lose: My legend is over...

dialogue.intro: Uh... Um... H-hello. P-pleased to meet you.
dialogue.win: S-s-sorry. I'm r-really n-nervous.
dialogue.lose: Uh... Th-thank you. That was f-fun.

dialogue.intro: Oh, this place is so passé now. I'm missing out on shopping.
dialogue.win: You're kind of stylish, actually. Oh, I wish I had new clothes.
dialogue.lose: Maybe I'll collect Accessories for some Contests...

dialogue.intro: Exam season's coming up, but I'm neck-deep in battling...
dialogue.win: Mom's going to cut me off. I just know it...
dialogue.lose: I have to keep up on both my studying and Pokémon...

dialogue.intro: Hiya, you Trainer there! Slip on some glasses. They'll make you look better.
dialogue.win: Nothing's the matter with my eyes. I wear glasses for the looks I get.
dialogue.lose: Whoops! My glasses, my glasses.

dialogue.intro: I've been taught every opponent has a weakness. If I can find yours...
dialogue.win: Eheheh. I figured out your weakness.
dialogue.lose: Did you figure out my weakness?

dialogue.intro: It's been so long since I had my last battle.
dialogue.win: You know, battling is fun after all.
dialogue.lose: Battling is so much fun, but...

dialogue.intro: The age of money has come to Pokémon battling. I'll teach you who is right.
dialogue.win: You understand, don't you? What is right, and who is stronger?
dialogue.lose: M-my Pokémon! What have you done? What am I to do?!

dialogue.intro: You're my opponent? Oh, all right... Try not to disappoint me too badly.
dialogue.win: My Pokémon are all tops in luxury. Do you see? This is what power is about.
dialogue.lose: Nyah! I don't care! I've got enough money to fill a swimming pool!

dialogue.intro: You there. Yes, you. I'm feeling rather bored.
dialogue.win: I suppose that was enjoyable for what it was. I thank you for it.
dialogue.lose: You are rather good. Quite remarkable, even.

dialogue.intro: I can sink your sort with minimal effort.
dialogue.win: It took the barest of efforts to win this match.
dialogue.lose: You swamped us with no effort at all...

dialogue.intro: My room is always full of bugs. That drives my mom just wild.
dialogue.win: I want to collect more bug Pokémon for my bug appreciation station.
dialogue.lose: Bugs are loose under my shirt. I'm starting to itch...

dialogue.intro: People claim I'm like an adult. Whatever could they mean, do you suppose?
dialogue.win: Ah, yes, quite enjoyable! We must do this again, surely.
dialogue.lose: Oh, yes! Smashing! That chilled me to my toes, it did!

dialogue.intro: I have made my choice. When I fall, it shall be forward!
dialogue.win: You lack conviction.
dialogue.lose: ...Thud.

dialogue.intro: So, what exactly is a ninja you may ask.
dialogue.win: A ninja is powerful. That will do as a start.
dialogue.lose: Maybe some ninjas are weak?

dialogue.intro: I once saw a lady wearing the same outfit as me.
dialogue.win: She said, “You're showing serious fashion chops.”
dialogue.lose: She said, “You're kidding me am I right?”

dialogue.intro: Will you believe that inside this costume is a grown-up Beauty?
dialogue.win: My dream is to live as a Pokémon one day. To become a Pokémon!
dialogue.lose: I'm an adult, but I want to be a Pokémon. Does that make me weird?

dialogue.intro: My profile's riding high now, so my schedule's filled solid!
dialogue.win: Oh, no! It's this late already? I'd better check my timetable!
dialogue.lose: Talent manager! Do I have time for a rematch?

dialogue.intro: Are you another of my fans? I can give you an autograph if you'd lose?
dialogue.win: Here's your autograph! Cherish it! Oh, sorry! I don't do handshakes.
dialogue.lose: I'm sorry, I was acting Gastly! It was very Delcatty of me!

dialogue.intro: I need to diet. I have to get out jogging.
dialogue.win: Well, I guess I'll go for a quick trot around here...
dialogue.lose: Your Pokémon know how to punch hard. You see, I'm really a boxer.

dialogue.intro: I look to bug Pokémon for hints on running all the time.
dialogue.win: I admire the light and agile footwork of bug Pokémon.
dialogue.lose: Skitter...

dialogue.intro: Listen, I'm feeling bushed today. Can we do this tomorrow first thing?
dialogue.win: Oh, all right. You're impatient. Couldn't wait till tomorrow, oh no.
dialogue.lose: That's why I said tomorrow. I can barely stay awake now.

dialogue.intro: Feed the Pokémon you catch, or they will flee. Do you see?
dialogue.win: Once a Pokémon has fled, it will never return. Do you see?
dialogue.lose: What I said about Pokémon--it is a parable. Do you see?

dialogue.intro: When I was younger, I went out on digs chasing rumors of hidden treasures.
dialogue.win: Of course, there are no such things. But it's about chasing a dream.
dialogue.lose: Well, it sure left huge holes... In the ground and in my bank account.

dialogue.intro: I'll launch an avalanche of moves! I'll test your limits of endurance!
dialogue.win: Well, Trainer? Should I try out some more moves?
dialogue.lose: That's it! I'm all out of stock! I'd like you to leave so I can close up!

dialogue.intro: I collect and battle Pokémon so I can brag to my peers.
dialogue.win: I'm not all that interested in winning or losing to begin with.
dialogue.lose: You've won the battle. But, in terms of the Pokémon involved, I clearly win.

dialogue.intro: Did you want to see my Pokémon? OK, sure. Just a peek, though.
dialogue.win: How's that for classy? My Pokémon are tops in both moves and character.
dialogue.lose: Hold it right there! You can look, but don't touch!

dialogue.intro: Rock? Samba? Traditional folk? I can play in any style. It's all good!
dialogue.win: Music and Pokémon uplift me! I'm carried up among the stars!
dialogue.lose: Sigh... I'm seeing stars... You've got me singing the blues...

dialogue.intro: Let my exquisite melody ring out! Hear my Pokémon shout out!
dialogue.win: The melody from my Pokémon and me... Did it reach out and touch your heart?
dialogue.lose: I've been known to throw matches, but I'll never throw a guitar on stage!

dialogue.intro: I'm free like a bird! I feel like I could fly!
dialogue.win: That's how I ended up becoming a Bird Keeper.
dialogue.lose: Like most birds, I can't see very well at night.

dialogue.intro: As a Trainer, I'm as fragile as an egg. Please be gentle on me.
dialogue.win: Do you think I'm getting ready to take flight?
dialogue.lose: One of these days, I'll break out of my shell and defeat you.

dialogue.intro: Bear witness to my display of machismo and masculinity!
dialogue.win: There! That's how a real man lives and battles!
dialogue.lose: Waaaah! Waaaah! Mommy!

dialogue.intro: I've got a showdown coming up with a Hiker. Let me see if I'm ready!
dialogue.win: Yep, I'd say my team's about ready. That Hiker won't know what hit him!
dialogue.lose: Aww, blast it, no! I can't beat that Hiker like this!

dialogue.intro: My showdown against a man of the sea draws near! Let me test my team!
dialogue.win: Everything went as calculated... Be ready for me, man of the sea!
dialogue.lose: Beating the man of the sea is impossible with an outcome this lame...

dialogue.intro: Uhho uho-uho uhho hohoi! This dance I use to psych myself up.
dialogue.win: Uhho uho-uho uhho hohoi! So much fun, I cannot stop.
dialogue.lose: Uhho uho-uho uhho hohoi! I dance to stem my tears from losing...

dialogue.intro: I'm not really with the police. I'm a collector of uniforms.
dialogue.win: Battling as a Policeman made for a very fun battle, it did.
dialogue.lose: That's it for me. I bid you a fond farewell.

dialogue.intro: I'm a Policeman. But on holidays, I'm an entirely different kind of guy.
dialogue.win: Usually, I chase after bad guys as a Policeman.
dialogue.lose: On my days off, I chase after the waves and the ladies as a Swimmer.

dialogue.intro: Perseverance pays off. A case can turn on that.
dialogue.win: It makes for more excitement when you come from behind to take the win.
dialogue.lose: That was more thrilling than any stakeout! Thanks for that!

dialogue.intro: My present case can go either way. It's a coin toss.
dialogue.win: So, I won this time... All decided by a fickle coin...
dialogue.lose: Best two out of three?

dialogue.intro: I live in the woods. You know, I'm a Camper.
dialogue.win: I'm working on making camp life more comfortable.
dialogue.lose: I am sick and tired of camping out in the woods...

dialogue.intro: No, no, I can't do this! I'm not cut out for battling!
dialogue.win: Oh, wow! I won! What'll I do? You're not mad at me, are you?
dialogue.lose: See! I told you before we started! Battling just isn't for me.

dialogue.intro: Trainer spotted! It's time to get cooking!
dialogue.win: A battle should be enjoyed like a tasty meal!
dialogue.lose: I ended up getting cooked!

dialogue.intro: Fweeoo-fwee-fwee-fyoo... I saunter into battle, whistling...
dialogue.win: Too easy! I was whistling all the way through that.
dialogue.lose: Fwee-ooo fwee-ooo fwee-ooo... I switched to an ambulance siren...

dialogue.intro: I can hear it... The screaming adulation of 100,000 fans rising in unison...
dialogue.win: Right on, everyone! You saw that! I dedicate my win to you!
dialogue.lose: You're scorching... You've made a fan out of me.

dialogue.intro: Number one worldwide, that's my dream. Well, to start, anyway.
dialogue.win: “Number one worldwide,” now doesn't that have a good ring to it?
dialogue.lose: I can't quite decide what I should be number one worldwide at.

dialogue.intro: I'm not some cheap Idol! I'm an actress! Please remember that!
dialogue.win: My career isn't anything like your typical Idol's career!
dialogue.lose: I'm an actress... It sounds so deliciously right...

dialogue.intro: We're not here for a long time, so let's make it a good time!
dialogue.win: Thank you! That was soooo fun! I really hope we can battle again!
dialogue.lose: It makes me sad having to say good-bye... Please come see me again!

dialogue.intro: I am the Fan Club Division Manager... Bring your best to bear...
dialogue.win: Kneel before the might of the Fan Club!
dialogue.lose: Gweh! But I did my best! Regrets, I have none!

dialogue.intro: I welcome you, young Trainer. Allow me to demonstrate my power.
dialogue.win: Young Trainer, do you have any idea what my power signifies?
dialogue.lose: You've surpassed me in your love of Pokémon. You're the truest of fans.

dialogue.intro: I think I'll try out the TM the woman next door gave me.
dialogue.win: I am impressed. That woman actually gave me something useful.
dialogue.lose: Oh, that nasty woman! This TM is worthless!

dialogue.intro: I heard that! I may be old enough to be your mom, but I'm still young!
dialogue.win: Look at my skin tone and my Pokémon! Both firm but supple!
dialogue.lose: Please don't make that mistake again! I'm young, I tell you!

dialogue.intro: Whether it be work or play, I'm with my Pokémon all day.
dialogue.win: Life without Pokémon? I can't picture that.
dialogue.lose: It's like I'm married to my Pokémon. I'm not married, though.

dialogue.intro: You get to be the best by working harder than everyone else.
dialogue.win: I reckon I've been a hard worker.
dialogue.lose: Work at battling over and over. Your star will shine one day.

dialogue.intro: I'm going to become famous here so I can rebuild the ranch.
dialogue.win: I can't lose. It's for my pa and ma.
dialogue.lose: If I can get famous, folks'll pay to visit my ranch...

dialogue.intro: From sundown, I live by candlelight until I go to sleep.
dialogue.win: That's not to say I don't have electric power on the homestead.
dialogue.lose: Candlelight can be very romantic.

dialogue.intro: I'd like to introduce you to my cherished partners.
dialogue.win: Good, good. Good going, gang. You guys all did great.
dialogue.lose: Wheeze... Wheeze... I'm feeling faint...

dialogue.intro: I'm no green thumb at growing Berries. Raising Pokémon is where I shine.
dialogue.win: I can give you tips on raising Pokémon so they'll grow tough.
dialogue.lose: Raising a living thing is never an easy job...

dialogue.intro: Pokémon are Pokémon, no matter how tough, weak, cute, or scary.
dialogue.win: Raise Pokémon with love, and they'll return it.
dialogue.lose: I think it's the Trainer who needs to pick up the pace here.

dialogue.intro: Raising a Pokémon right takes money and time.
dialogue.win: But it's all worthwhile when the Pokémon grows up.
dialogue.lose: To raise the ideal Pokémon I'm willing to work hard.

dialogue.intro: That's right, I'm tough. I won't lose. I don't think losing's possible.
dialogue.win: Yup, I'm so tough... Ehehe... Heeheehee...
dialogue.lose: I lost? But, how...? What now? What do I do?

dialogue.intro: I'm an Ace Trainer, so this is for bragging rights.
dialogue.win: Yup, you did good. No, seriously.
dialogue.lose: Heh... I've got a long ways to go...

dialogue.intro: I was looking forward to a battle with you!
dialogue.win: I was right! You are pretty decent. Why not become an Ace Trainer?
dialogue.lose: You're as good as the rumors say... May I have a rematch one day?

dialogue.intro: Look at me. I'm what you should be aspiring to be.
dialogue.win: You expected anything else?
dialogue.lose: You've already surpassed me. But you can aim so much higher.

dialogue.intro: My whole life hinges on this one battle! ...Lose for me, pretty please?
dialogue.win: Yeah! I won! It's all smooth sailing for me now!
dialogue.lose: I wasn't supposed to lose... That's my life derailed...

dialogue.intro: I'm running a fever here. Just so's you know.
dialogue.win: Oogh, my head's burning up. It makes me feel more inspired.
dialogue.lose: Like I said, I have a cold. I'm not on top of my game.

dialogue.intro: When we battle, I want you to be very careful. My coat's very expensive.
dialogue.win: Yikes! Eek! Watch out! You almost got Pokémon sweat on my coat!
dialogue.lose: I was worried about getting my coat dirty. Who cares about your battle?

dialogue.intro: I wish you'd leave. I don't want to see you lose.
dialogue.win: I told you so... Can you leave, please?
dialogue.lose: Listen...is being tough not always a good thing?

dialogue.intro: Whoa-whoa-whoa... Careful now! Maintaining balance is the key!
dialogue.win: Whoops...! Almost went over! Have to be careful here...
dialogue.lose: ...Waaaaaah... Thud!

dialogue.intro: Now don't you worry about a thing. You leave everything to me, OK?
dialogue.win: What do you say? Fun, hey? It'd be nice if we could meet again.
dialogue.lose: Well, I'll be! You sure got the best of me!

dialogue.intro: I will battle. It's not likely I will lose. I'm tough.
dialogue.win: I win. I could do a dance right now.
dialogue.lose: What is the matter? Why couldn't I win?

dialogue.intro: Mother Nature, I beseech you! Please, lend me strength!
dialogue.win: Oh, Mother Nature, I thank you! To you, I dedicate this victory!
dialogue.lose: I'm sorry, Mother Nature! I'm sorry to disappoint you!

dialogue.intro: A good Trainer takes on all challenges regardless of the foe or the rules.
dialogue.win: No Trainer can be considered bad if they battle the best they can.
dialogue.lose: A good Trainer doesn't gloat over a win. They just prepare for the next battle.

dialogue.intro: Come hither, my Pokémon! Please get rid of this mean Trainer!
dialogue.win: Ooh, yes, I love you, my sweeties! Come here and give me a kiss!
dialogue.lose: How could you?! You hurt my sweet little ones!

dialogue.intro: I'm fine with practice and training, but I wilt when the chips are down.
dialogue.win: I feel sick from tension! I'd rather be at home practicing!
dialogue.lose: If it's about practice, I'd be the champ without a doubt.

dialogue.intro: Hi-yah! Hah! Hah! One more! Hah! Hah!
dialogue.win: Boo-yah!
dialogue.lose: Hi-yah! ...No, wait! No!

dialogue.intro: Wanna?
dialogue.win: Heh...
dialogue.lose: You beat me? Where's your dojo?

dialogue.intro: Come oooon! C'mon, c'mon! Hey! Hey! C'mon, hey!
dialogue.win: Oh, yesssss!
dialogue.lose: Oh, noooooo!

dialogue.intro: Your eyes are unclouded by doubt. This match will be entertaining...
dialogue.win: From the bottom of my heart, I look forward to your return.
dialogue.lose: Whew... A most entertaining match. I hope you'll grant me a rematch.

dialogue.intro: You need to be taught what wisdom of age means in battle!
dialogue.win: I'll have you know that no child can hope to defeat me!
dialogue.lose: That did not happen! Unfair! I demand a rematch right now!

dialogue.intro: I'm feeling cranky today! Help me get my mind off it!
dialogue.win: Whew... A battle is the perfect stress reliever!
dialogue.lose: Eeeeeeeeh! You've pushed me over to furious!

dialogue.intro: Cue battle music, please! I want to trumpet my victory!
dialogue.win: I love the battle music. It sets my heart racing.
dialogue.lose: Fine, that will do. Back to the regular theme music.

dialogue.intro: When you've been a Trainer as long as I have, let's just say you'll see a lot.
dialogue.win: Things like this happen. Don't let it get you down.
dialogue.lose: People and Pokémon are all different. Isn't that what makes it beautiful?

dialogue.intro: My big brother told me to go for the eyes! Aim for the eyes!
dialogue.win: I did it, big brother!
dialogue.lose: My big brother told me to wreck the other Trainer's accuracy!

dialogue.intro: I hear my Pokémon calling out... They clamor to battle...
dialogue.win: I hear my Pokémon calling out... They call for your return...
dialogue.lose: I hear my Pokémon calling out... They tell me of the fun they had...

dialogue.intro: Behind you, I see light. What is its significance?
dialogue.win: I thought I saw an aura of invincibility. I must have been mistaken.
dialogue.lose: Now I see... You glow with the light of victory...

dialogue.intro: I'll deliver defeat to you elegantly and speedily.
dialogue.win: Thank you for your patience!
dialogue.lose: I'm so terribly sorry. I ended up with your intended defeat.

dialogue.intro: Great, another tough-looking Trainer. The fun never ends for me.
dialogue.win: Bleah, that was too close for comfort. Nothing ever comes easy for me.
dialogue.lose: Yeah, see? I knew I'd lose. If only that move landed...

dialogue.intro: Everyone has too much to say about Pokémon! If it's fun, that's enough!
dialogue.win: Excuse me, but are you all right? Maybe you're a little too tired?
dialogue.lose: If you get too caught up in winning and losing, you'll burn yourself out.

dialogue.intro: Aren't you the cutest guest! You can expect the best service from me!
dialogue.win: Well, were you impressed by the level of service I provided?
dialogue.lose: Oh, wait, please! I'm not done serving you!

dialogue.intro: I keep a journal about the lives of the Trainers who arrive here.
dialogue.win: In our vast world, I wonder how many Trainers will cross my path?
dialogue.lose: Every encounter ends in parting. That's why I keep a journal.

dialogue.intro: I've waited all my life for someone like you. I'm never letting you go.
dialogue.win: It was a ploy to confuse you with words out of some romance movie.
dialogue.lose: Now, go on, don't let me hold you back. Seize your chance at happiness!

dialogue.intro: Will you give me an interview if you win?
dialogue.win: You made my job too easy. You need to buckle down.
dialogue.lose: Your feelings now, in a word! Shout it into the mike, please!

dialogue.intro: I'm on a diet... I'm so famished...
dialogue.win: I'm happy, but if I get excited, I'll get hungry. No thanks...
dialogue.lose: Oh... Your Pokémon look delicious...

dialogue.intro: Let me make it clear right now, I'm tougher than you can stand!
dialogue.win: See? I wasn't exaggerating!
dialogue.lose: Who are you exactly?!

dialogue.intro: Clear the way! Out of the way! Wait! Don't go! We have to battle!
dialogue.win: Come on, take it up a gear! Keep up with me!
dialogue.lose: OK, out of the way! Clear the way! Let this loser run away!

dialogue.intro: Safe driving and safer battling. That's my motto.
dialogue.win: You can be patient in a battle. Victory will come eventually.
dialogue.lose: I'll keep to my own pace. I'll catch up to you one day.

dialogue.intro: I only have this Bike to look good for the guys. I can't actually ride.
dialogue.win: It was a pain getting this Bike here. I had to push it all the way!
dialogue.lose: I'm only concerned about looking good. I don't practice enough.

dialogue.intro: I'm not looking for any excitement. I don't need any drama.
dialogue.win: A battle is all the excitement I need.
dialogue.lose: I recently realized that I'm not cut out for this scary job.

dialogue.intro: I'll battle my way. You battle yours.
dialogue.win: People are people. I'll go my own way.
dialogue.lose: People are people. You go your own way.

dialogue.intro: Today, I have a special treat for all my fans!
dialogue.win: Thank you! I love your support!
dialogue.lose: Are you really one of my fans?

dialogue.intro: I'm burnt out on being an Idol. I want to go home to the country...
dialogue.win: I can't quit now! Kids dream of being me!
dialogue.lose: I miss hearing my mother's voice...

dialogue.intro: I'm one of a kind. That's what I'm saying.
dialogue.win: I keep it real. That's what makes me tough.
dialogue.lose: I kept it real, but you won anyway. Your reality was more real.

dialogue.intro: Hi! Are you my next opponent? Let's keep it clean and fair!
dialogue.win: It feels great going all out with no dirty tricks.
dialogue.lose: That was an awesome workout! We have to do this again sometime!

dialogue.intro: My needs are simple. Fishing and Moomoo Milk are all I need.
dialogue.win: Winning or losing isn't something I pay heed to.
dialogue.lose: I could use some Moomoo Milk right about now.

dialogue.intro: You there! Take a look at the Pokémon I fished up the other day.
dialogue.win: I can tell you're impressed. This guy I don't know how long it took to land.
dialogue.lose: A word of advice: when an older person is bragging, pretend to be interested.

dialogue.intro: You're a Trainer. Let your Pokémon do the talking.
dialogue.win: Where's your spirit? That didn't speak to me at all.
dialogue.lose: Great! Great! Your feelings came across!

dialogue.intro: Here comes your prey! Get 'em! Chaaaarge!
dialogue.win: Gaahahaha! That's it! Good job!
dialogue.lose: We're outmatched! Pull back, guys! Run away!

dialogue.intro: Bring it on! Ooooh! Haaah!
dialogue.win: Thank you kindly!
dialogue.lose: Thanks for having me!

dialogue.intro: I am captivated by the mountains. They're the main thing in my life!
dialogue.win: The mountains mean more to me than any battle, no matter how fun!
dialogue.lose: Your battle skills are impressive, but I can't wait to return to the mountains.

dialogue.intro: We're going to hammer you, kid. Don't freeze up and close your eyes.
dialogue.win: I like how you stay defiant even after losing. Good attitude, kid.
dialogue.lose: Honest, I didn't let up one bit or let down my guard because you're a kid.

dialogue.intro: I battle around the globe. I'm a worldwide bad boy!
dialogue.win: I don't lose at battling. I can't get over how cool I am!
dialogue.lose: I'm hitting the road over that loss. It's good-bye to the old me!

dialogue.intro: Battles, I'm good at. But musical aptitude? Forget it.
dialogue.win: This whole battling thing is good, but I wish I could play music as well.
dialogue.lose: Music or Pokémon... It's a tough choice.

dialogue.intro: I wrote a song using the cries of Pokémon. I'd like you to hear it.
dialogue.win: Graaah wagyaaah! Wagyaaaah! Chu! Chu! Gyaroooh-gah!
dialogue.lose: Giiyaaaah! Drundundun! Garoo-gah! Wawawaaah!

dialogue.intro: I'm bored of collecting and hoarding. I'm getting rid of everything now.
dialogue.win: There's nothing that I really want now. Maybe I'll become a clown...
dialogue.lose: I threw the match for a start. It's nice to be unburdened of things.

dialogue.intro: Oh! Hold on a second! Incoming text message!
dialogue.win: Ticka-ticka-ticka... Ticka-tick... Huh? Is it over already?
dialogue.lose: Hey, stop that! No peeking at my text messages!

dialogue.intro: There's no meaning to this battle! Pokémon should be about love!
dialogue.win: Battling leaves me empty. Hug your Pokémon and show your love!
dialogue.lose: Battling creates nothing. Hug your Pokémon and show your love!

dialogue.intro: Are you challenging me? ...You are. Kids these days...
dialogue.win: Now run along home, and go help your mommy with her chores!
dialogue.lose: Hey, you... If you think playtime will last forever, you'll end up like me.

dialogue.intro: How will you counter my implacable logic?
dialogue.win: Everything according to calculation... This victory is a complete one.
dialogue.lose: You outcalculated me. I'm incredulous.

dialogue.intro: I've been ensconced in the lab. My shoulders are all knotted up.
dialogue.win: What a refreshing break! I'm feeling loose and relaxed now.
dialogue.lose: My Pokémon and I, we all need to get outside and exercise more.

dialogue.intro: Hmmm... So young... I may have to go easy...
dialogue.win: You're so depressingly young... It's fine. You may go.
dialogue.lose: Consider the loser's feelings. That's where you young people fail...

dialogue.intro: You see an old man, yes? Don't be fooled by the way I look.
dialogue.win: I find it abhorrent to lose to any young Trainer.
dialogue.lose: I was fooled by your youth. Foolish, foolish me...

dialogue.intro: As a Worker, it's my job to both build and demolish.
dialogue.win: Why don't you become a Worker, too? I find it fun and rewarding.
dialogue.lose: Making things is harder than demolishing, but it's more satisfying.

dialogue.intro: You and your Pokémon, I'll clean up on you easily.
dialogue.win: Well, well, how pathetic was that. Take your passengers and go home.
dialogue.lose: Gwaah... So heavy... My guys buckled under the load.

dialogue.intro: Outstanding athleticism and a great sense of humor; that's a clown!
dialogue.win: A clown is a job of greatness. Only the chosen can become one!
dialogue.lose: The ability to laugh off disappointment is another requirement for a clown!

dialogue.intro: Laugh with the face and cry with the heart; that's how a clown lives.
dialogue.win: Ahahahahaha!
dialogue.lose: Gah! ...Ahahahaha!

dialogue.intro: Oi, listen! I'm a Policeman, sure, but a Trainer before that!
dialogue.win: What? A Policeman can't lose his temper?
dialogue.lose: Yes, I'm a Policeman, but I have dreams and aspirations, and, and... Snivel...

dialogue.intro: Hands up! Put 'em where I can see 'em! You're all under arrest!
dialogue.win: Case closed!
dialogue.lose: This is a gross miscarriage of justice!

dialogue.intro: I'll have you know that I'm an Internet detective.
dialogue.win: My powers of observation and logic prevailed!
dialogue.lose: Think you've outsmarted me? Maybe this was just a sting operation!

dialogue.intro: Wherever, whenever, and with whomever. That's my motto!
dialogue.win: When, where, or whom... It doesn't matter at all to me.
dialogue.lose: Hahaha! This is great! I want to keep this going!

dialogue.intro: The loser has to pretend to be a Stunky, OK?
dialogue.win: Giggle, you lose. I want to see your Stunky impression!
dialogue.lose: OK, here's my Stunky impression! Three, two, one...

dialogue.intro: A good breeze has sprung up... This is good! I can win this!
dialogue.win: The tailwind put us over the top! ...As they say!
dialogue.lose: The headwind worked against us! ...As they say!

dialogue.intro: Even though I always have my parasol up, I actually like sunny days.
dialogue.win: I hope it will be sunny tomorrow...
dialogue.lose: The heavy downpour in my heart... When will it ever stop...?

dialogue.intro: My, you're very eager to go. I'd better take the tension up a notch, too!
dialogue.win: I had a lot of fun with that match! Wouldn't it be nice to see you again!
dialogue.lose: You're so full of energy! Why, I feel energized, too!

dialogue.intro: How much longer do I have to wait for a Trainer that's any good?
dialogue.win: I'm so bored by the weak competition. Maybe I'll just retire.
dialogue.lose: Oh, hello, there. Now, you're a little special.

dialogue.intro: My ladylike charms don't mean a thing to a little kid...
dialogue.win: That was too close for comfort! It doesn't pay to underestimate foes.
dialogue.lose: Battling fair and square doesn't appeal to me. I'd rather win.

dialogue.intro: Like everything else, people have likes and dislikes when it comes to scents.
dialogue.win: I love how Pokémon smell after a battle.
dialogue.lose: I feel a little thrill if I catch a whiff of intense effort postbattle.

dialogue.intro: Sniff, sniff... Yes! Here it comes! Aroma power!
dialogue.win: With aroma power, I'm invincible!
dialogue.lose: Fizzle... I'm out of aroma power...

dialogue.intro: Turn, step, turn, turn... I'll practice my dance steps while battling!
dialogue.win: I dance with passion and precision. How can there be a weakness?
dialogue.lose: You're throwing off my rhythm! My dance routine is ruined!

dialogue.intro: I'm always ready for the public eye. You can come at me at your own pace.
dialogue.win: That's why people consider me the perfect Idol.
dialogue.lose: I didn't know how bad it feels to lose. This is a first for me.

dialogue.win: Ah, wonderful! That was fantastic! Do come again!
dialogue.lose: I have no problem with losing to a spectacular Trainer like you!

dialogue.win: Ah, wonderful! That was fantastic! Do come again!
dialogue.lose: I have no problem with losing to a spectacular Trainer like you!

dialogue.intro: What Pokémon do you want up on stage? I can't wait!
dialogue.win: That was a most enjoyable time! Thank you! Come again, please.
dialogue.lose: Oh... I detest how fun times seem to end so quickly.

dialogue.intro: What Pokémon do you want to show off this time? I can't wait!
dialogue.win: How wonderful that was! Thank you! Come again, please.
dialogue.lose: It's so sad how the truly fun times seem to last only a moment.

dialogue.intro: It doesn't matter what you throw at me. I'll always win. My investigative and analytical system is truly amazing.
dialogue.win: See? Just as analyzed.
dialogue.lose: Whoa! You sure showed me!

dialogue.intro: It doesn't matter what you throw at me. I'll always win. I'll stake my investigative and analytical system on it!
dialogue.win: See? Just as analyzed.
dialogue.lose: Whoa! You sure showed me!

dialogue.intro: Always be smiling! Luck comes to those who are happy! That's why I always keep a big smile and believe in my Pokémon when I battle.
dialogue.win: You're very good! I had a lot of fun!
dialogue.lose: You're so very, very good! My Pokémon had a good time, too!

dialogue.intro: Whenever I battle someone tough I smile. I cannot help it! How about you? What do you do? Do you laugh? Cry? Get angry?
dialogue.win: Win or lose, whenever I battle someone wonderful, I am happy!
dialogue.lose: Battling a wonderful Trainer is always a happy occasion!

dialogue.intro: Very well... Shall we begin?
dialogue.win: Ah, a most valiant effort. Though I was lucky enough to win this time, the next time...
dialogue.lose: My Pokémon could not be faulted in any way, shape, or form. My hat's off to you.

dialogue.intro: This is for Lady Caitlin's sake. I'm afraid I must go all out.
dialogue.win: Ah, a most valiant effort. Though I was lucky enough to win this time, the next time...
dialogue.lose: Your skills are superlative as ever! My admiration knows no bounds.
